description:
## The inconsistency

`lib/enum.fz` holds 27 `if` expressions beside a set of helpers that make the same decisions by dispatch: `all_value_step/1`, `any_value_step/1`, `find_value_step/2`, `find_index_step/2`, `count_result/2`, `member_result/3` each take a value and answer with a clause per case. Half the module uses that idiom and half does not.

The worst of it is `drop_while/2` and `split_while/2`, where an `if` sits inside an `if` inside a closure inside a call -- four levels to express a two-way choice:

```
fn drop_while(enumerable, fun) do
  drop_while_finish(
    reduce_while(enumerable, {[], true}, fn (entry, {acc, dropping}) ->
      {:cont,
       if dropping do
         if fun.(entry), do: {acc, true}, else: {[entry | acc], false}
       else
         {[entry | acc], false}
       end}
    end)
  )
end
```

The same shape appears in `take_every/2`, `drop_every/2`, `map_every_list/4`, `filter_list/2`, `merge_sort_lists/3`, `extreme_fold/3`, `extreme_by_fold/5`, `dedup_after/2`, `dedup_by_after/3`, `chunk_by_run/4` and `uniq_walk/3`.

## What to do

Give each of these a named helper that dispatches on the decided value, the way the existing step helpers do. `take_positive/2` is the clearest case: the helper it wants already exists as `take_positive_step/2` and is simply not called.

This is a body rewrite, not a behaviour change. Every function keeps its result.

## Watch the goldens

Four fixtures pin allocation counts and could move: `enum_builder_allocations`, `enum_list_allocations`, `enum_reduce_suspend`, `enum_sort`. A lower count is safe by construction -- a stricter floor. A raise is a finding and wants explaining before it is blessed.

## Acceptance

- No `if` nested inside another `if` anywhere in the module.
- Each remaining `if` is a one-line choice between two values, or is gone.
- Allocation goldens unchanged or lower, with any change explained.

comments.text: Implemented clause-driven decision helpers across the specified Enum functions. The structural test was proven red before the rewrite and now pins that every remaining code-level if is a single one-line value choice. Elixir oracle and all 715 fixture-matrix legs pass; allocation goldens are unchanged (including enum_sort at 22 cells / 352 bytes native), and the sort recursion stays beside cons construction to preserve reuse. Compiler census changes account for the concrete helper specializations without blind escapes or unexplained work; the existing fz-f98.14.3 audit establishes this breadth is linear and dispatch-relevant. Full gates: compiler 2020 passed / 6 ignored, runtime 260 passed, CLI 30 passed, doctests, AOT, clippy -D warnings, fmt, and diff checks all green. Commit: 178805b59.

title: Enum: decide with clauses where the module already decides with clauses
